esqlQuery.esql:
FROM chargeback_lookup.billing_cluster_cost
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL
| EVAL obs_ts = COALESCE(group_first_seen, @timestamp)
| INLINE STATS org_earliest_ts = MIN(@timestamp), org_latest_ts = MAX(@timestamp), org_latest_obs_ts = MAX(obs_ts)
| EVAL ref_latest_ts = CASE(org_latest_obs_ts > org_latest_ts, org_latest_obs_ts, org_latest_ts)
| WHERE deployment_group IS NOT NULL AND deployment_group != ""
| STATS first_seen = MIN(obs_ts) BY deployment_group, org_earliest_ts, ref_latest_ts
| WHERE ref_latest_ts > org_earliest_ts AND first_seen > org_earliest_ts AND first_seen >= ref_latest_ts - 3 days
| EVAL first_seen_day = LEFT(TO_STRING(first_seen), 10),
       result = CONCAT("New chargeback group `", deployment_group, "` first observed on ", first_seen_day, ".")
| SORT deployment_group ASC
| KEEP result, deployment_group, first_seen_day
